name: Summer Art Camp
description_short: Small group art, fashion and design camp at The Boston Artistry studio in Hingham for ages 6 to 17, with weekday morning (8:30 to 11:30), afternoon (12 to 3) and full day (8:30 to 3) options. Campers paint, do mixed media and make wearable art such as custom sneakers, shirts and totes.
refund_policy_summary: Cancel at least 7 days before camp starts for studio credit only; camp fees are not refunded as cash. Later cancellations, missed days and no shows get no refund or credit.
